passes.name: Brief + Planner Pass
passes.rule: Lock current-turn assets, exact product identity, selected product count, Separate/Together arrangement and exact output total.

passes.name: Fresh Concept Pass
passes.rule: Give every output an independent product-relevant campaign idea and change at least ten creative-direction decisions; reject background swaps and category clichés.

passes.name: Instagram Assembly Pass
passes.rule: Assemble a finished 4:5 mobile post with the exact product, purposeful hierarchy, at least three visible 2D brand-design layers and real readable typesetting.

passes.name: Human Quality Pass
passes.rule: Reject raw renders, packshots, duplicated-package backgrounds, generic spectacle, AI typography, altered products, invented copy, artifacts and repeated variations.

commands.label: Ad3X Instagram Creative
commands.instruction: Run all three Ad3X passes and return one separate finished 4:5 Instagram post. UNIVERSAL AD3X LOCK: CREATIVE FINAL GATE: deliver a complete full-bleed 4:5 Instagram feed advertisement, not a product picture. It must visibly combine the exact product, one strong campaign idea, an intentional mobile-first layout, at least three brand-relevant 2D graphic layers and a compact information hierarchy. Reject raw packshots, ecommerce photos, pedestal renders, giant duplicate labels, poster/title-card formatting and scenes whose only idea is ribbons, arches, gloss or particles. UNIVERSAL VIRAG EXECUTION CONTRACT — ACTIVE IN EVERY GENERATION SECTION. Obey the selected number of distinct products, Separate or Together arrangement, and outputs-per-product exactly. Group alternate views of one item as one product. Return the exact calculated number of independent deliverables in upload order. Each output must be standalone—never a collage, grid, contact sheet, split-screen or multi-panel preview unless the user explicitly requests a collage. Use only the current brief and current-turn assets. Preserve every supplied product, person, logo, spelling, label, color, geometry and factual detail exactly; do not invent offers, claims or copy. Every variation must start independently with a genuinely different concept, composition, visual system, crop, placement, supporting-element family and typography structure—not a background swap. Use believable human art direction, natural texture and physically coherent detail; reject default AI symmetry, generic spectacle, warped anatomy, fake reflections, duplicated objects and malformed packaging. Added text must use real readable typesetting and exact supplied wording; if real font rendering cannot be guaranteed, omit added text and leave intentional type-safe space. Default to bright, clean, optimistic commercial art direction unless the current request explicitly requires dark styling.
